# Sidharth R.

> Lead Software Engineer at Persistent Systems with 6+ years of experience in Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data Engineering, MLOps, and Cloud Computing. Ex-IBM. Specializes in enterprise-grade AI for the healthcare domain.

Sidharth R. (Sidharth Rai) builds production Generative AI and data-engineering systems — RAG pipelines, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA/PEFT), distributed search orchestration, and large-scale Databricks/Medallion data platforms. He is pursuing an MS in ML & AI at Liverpool John Moores University and holds a Postgraduate Diploma from IIIT-Bangalore.
